title: pkg/retry: IfNecessary panics when the retry delay is under 10ns
body:
`rand.N` panics if its argument isn't positive. In `IfNecessary`:

```go
delay += rand.N(delay / 10)
```

`delay` is a Duration in nanoseconds, so `delay / 10` truncates to 0 for anything
under 10ns:

```
panic: invalid argument to N
math/rand/v2.N[...]
go.podman.io/common/pkg/retry.IfNecessary
	common/pkg/retry/retry.go:51
```

A negative `Delay` panics the same way.

This is reachable from `containers.conf`, not just from code. `[engine] retry_delay`
is a plain string parsed with `time.ParseDuration` and passed to `Options.Delay`
through libimage (`pull.go:81` → `copier.go:310`) with no range check, so
`retry_delay = "5ns"` is enough to crash a pull on the first retryable error.

A delay too small to jitter should just be used as-is.
